The '''HA-5 Aerial Retreat''' was an unusual [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] that functioned more as a mobile dwelling than a traditional vehicle. Resembling a floating, square, three-story building, it relied on massive [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|drives]] housed in the bottom level to remain airborne. The middle level contained amenities such as a galley, climate systems, and storage, while the top floor and open roof were reserved for daily life, offering quarters, a lounge with [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] boards, a bar, and other luxuries. The interior could be easily reconfigured to include features like [[Net-ball]] courts or [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] garages.

Primarily used by vacationing tourists or wealthy nobles, the HA-5 also served as an ideal venue for diplomatic summits, offering both comfort and privacy. Though not stealthy, its unassuming purpose often prevented outside scrutiny. For this reason, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] occasionally held secret meetings aboard HA-5s owned by sympathetic individuals.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HA-5 aerial retreat was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
